note: Columbus County's zoning districts are published only through the County's MangoMap web viewer (Columbus MAP), which exposes no ArcGIS REST or downloadable polygon service; no public FeatureServer/MapServer was found. The county's zoning ordinance defines zoning areas with unshaded land as General Use (G-U). The City of Whiteville publishes its zoning only as a PDF map. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Columbus County NC zoning returned no service.
